notes.author: agent:claude
notes.text: The README and the brief describe the project as open source while the repository carries no license and package.json is marked private. Choosing the license is a human decision and should be made before any public sharing, because code published without one is not usable by anyone else.

notes.author: user
notes.text: Approved publishing the repository publicly under the MIT license. Use the GitHub account identity when no legal display name is configured. npm publication remains a separate step.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Prepared public-source publication under MIT with copyright holder pioootrek, repository metadata, third-party notices, and a production dependency license review. The locked production graph contains 342 MIT, 18 ISC, 8 Apache-2.0, 7 BSD-3-Clause, 4 BSD-2-Clause, 2 BlueOak-1.0.0, and one each of 0BSD, CC-BY-4.0, LGPL-3.0-or-later, and Python-2.0. shadcn/ui copied-source attribution is preserved. Keep this item open because npm packing, clean global-install validation, pre-1.0 release confirmation, and npm publication are not part of the public repository operation.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Published https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher as a public GitHub repository with main as the default branch. GitHub recognizes the MIT license. The source archive was packed, inspected for state and secret files, installed into a clean npm prefix, and smoke-tested through config path, config mcp, and a loopback dashboard start. Keep the item open for the separate npm registry release decision; package.json intentionally remains private.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Latest owner direction explicitly keeps reusability and exploratory adoption in scope. Raised the lightweight package trial to next; account systems and a public marketing campaign are not dependencies. MIT/public-source work is already completed.

problem: MIT licensing, public GitHub metadata, and a historical package smoke test already exist. The package remains private and unpublished; a fresh install outside the source checkout is not yet a repeatable experiment path.

risk.rollback: Keep the current public MIT source available and the registry package private until publication is explicitly authorized. Revert trial packaging changes if the clean install fails; preserve the last working artifact and all user state.

scope: Use FEAT-20260905-portable-verification for a fresh packed-artifact installation and document the shortest install -> add repository -> use with an MCP client path.
Keep a tarball/source trial available before registry publication. State supported platforms, setup requirements, prototype limitations, and how to remove the tool while preserving user data.

When the owner chooses to publish, confirm the pre-1.0 version, recheck package contents/notices, remove private, and publish as a separate explicit operation. Do not redo the completed license choice.
title: Prepare a reusable package trial and an optional first npm release
validation: Verify a new installation outside the source tree runs the CLI and packaged dashboard and can register a portable fixture repository.
Verify MCP setup works without putting tokens in documentation, source, ordinary logs, or chat.
Verify package contents include required assets/license/skill and exclude application state, logs, credentials, and owner-specific configuration.
Record trial friction and owner workflow benefit. npm publication requires its own authorization; user recruitment counts are not release gates.
value: The owner gets reproducible installation and upgrades, and other developers can try the experiment with little setup.
